White Wedding - Billy Idol (1982) #80s #80er #Retro #WeLove80s

Everyone assumes this is about Idol's real sister. It's not.

His sister Jane really was pregnant and getting married — that's what sparked the idea. But "little sister" in the lyrics is actually his nickname for his ex-girlfriend, not his real sibling. He twisted it into a story about a vengeful brother coming back to avenge her "shotgun wedding" — half true, half fiction.

The kicker? He wrote the entire song in about 15 minutes with just a drum machine and his guitar. And when his actual sister's wedding happened, he couldn't even make it — he was in America.
